name: adopt public standard protocols for the orchestration platform
asks: I suspect our entire work orchestration platform that we have been growing would benefit from learning about our prior art in metroplat and agential-relationality about how to use public standard protocols for stuff. EAVT, Datom, RDF, SPARQL, ActivityPub. By using these, I suspect we could just, massively simplify our stuff, make it more standard, and more familiar to all workers coming here. I want to make these changes, I am the emsenn the Chairperson saying I know from outside experience this is worth the cost of doing right now.
